claims.evidence: Witness report only describes a washing machine in a photo; location/availability at Abulegba is not shown.
Witness report: brand label reads “NEXUS” on the front (photo 0).

risks.risk: Exact model/series and capacity (kg) are not readable, which affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/series plate (usually on the door frame or back panel) showing model number and capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity Nexus top-loader with limited specs (worst-case value).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (wash/spin/heating, no error lights shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing a full test cycle: power on, selecting a program, drum turning/spin, and any status/error lights (or a working spin-only test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs service/repair).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (dents, rust, leaks, worn hoses/rubber feet) could require immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Photos of: front corners, base area, door seal/gasket, and all hoses (inlet/drain) plus a close-up of any rust/leak spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cosmetic/maintenance work (worst-case: possible leaks/hoses).

risks.risk: Power rating/voltage and compatibility with Lagos supply are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V), frequency, and power consumption.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard but unverified electrical specs (worst-case: may require checks/adapter or service).

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness are unknown (hoses, drain hose, manual, warranty). Missing parts reduce usability.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included accessories: inlet hose, drain hose, power cable condition, manual, and any warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: missing hoses/manual).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the model/series plate (model number + capacity in kg).
Send a short video of a working test: power on, program selection, drum rotation and spin, and any error/status lights.
Send photos of the base and underside area for leaks/rust, plus close-ups of the door seal/gasket.
Send clear photos of inlet and drain hoses (condition and connectors).
Send a photo of the rating plate showing voltage/power rating.
Confirm and photograph included accessories (hoses, drain hose, manual/warranty if any).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Nexus washing machine, so it can be priced at its worst-case value for an unverified working condition and unknown model/capacity. Missing proof items mainly affect whether it should be discounted further, but a baseline price is still possible.
